command: unset PYTHONPATH; cd /tmp && $SC/cleanwheel/bin/python -m pip check; echo 'pip check exit='$?; echo -n 'installed: '; $SC/cleanwheel/bin/python -m pip list --format=freeze | tr '\n' ' '; echo; cd $SC && $SC/cleanwheel/bin/python $SC/import_sweep.py; echo 'sweep exit='$?
note: Run with PYTHONPATH cleared and cwd outside any checkout, so the installed distribution is what loads -- the sweep refuses outright if it detects a source/editable tree.
result: the 0.8.2 wheel installed into a fresh venv resolves to numpy 2.5.3 + scipy 1.18.1 and nothing else; `pip check` finds no broken requirements; the import sweep imports all 810 public modules cleanly
